media.title: Robert Z. Leonard — portrait, 1926
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the film director Robert Z. Leonard, 1926.
media.publicCaption: Robert Z. Leonard, published in The Motion Picture Director in July 1926. Leonard directed Escapade (1935) and Maytime (1937), both documented here.
media.publicCreditLine: Artist unknown; The Motion Picture Director, July 1926, via the Internet Archive and Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States: published in a magazine before 1 January 1931. The Wikimedia Commons file records the issue and links the Internet Archive scan, so the publication and its date are established rather than assumed.
